Metadata.Title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
Metadata.Name: Lower Audio Latency
Metadata.Note: Halves the time between the sound engine's updates (FromSoftware's MagicOrchestra over FMOD: MainThreadUpdateTime in its setup text, 33333 microseconds), so a sound the game starts plays sooner: 60 updates a second instead of 30, and 120 where another patch (Bloodborne's 60 FPS++) has made it 60 already. Found by the text itself, so every version of the game that has the line gets it.
